summary: Kerb against a treed bank; homes 19-30 m away across the road.
reasons: Backs onto treed bank, homes across road
No cars parked on this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Treed strip between the road and the lower carriageway on the kerb side; houses 30 m (at 146 m) and 19 m (at 164 m) across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street; ground beside the lane is a sloping bank, so room to pull fully off is uncertain.
drivers.traffic: Residential street, parked cars on the opposite kerb leave a narrower lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the opposite kerb, not along this one; a van would stand out a little.

flags: Steep elsewhere: mean grade 10.7%, up to 37%; about 3% here
Homes within 25 m across the road
sun_shade: Eucalypt canopy overhead, mostly from the south; mixed shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the bank allows a pull-off

best_section.where: South kerb of Jenkinson Street, beside the treed strip, opposite the house near the 146 m mark
